STAGE: scope/evidence check before writing the idea.
GOAL: confirm what evidence I can read locally and pick a curvature-as-design-target mechanism that is not a restatement of earlier rounds.
READ: working directory /fs04/ar57/wenyu/GeneRec/results/research/121/rounds/round_20261102_031529_470/agents/ideation_3 contains no .md files; a glob for results/research/**/curvature/report.md was refused (permission.rejected: external_directory). So the only available evidence is the round brief itself: 182 SID tables, standardised Ollivier curvature of the per-level behaviour quotient graph, L3 +0.26, L1 -0.16, L1-L3 -0.20 (p=0.0095), incremental R^2 ~1pp over SID-quality (R^2=0.60), strongest non-geometric predictors = number of used level-3 codes (+0.42) and collision rate (-0.39), plus the Issue #127 failure (coarse 17-cell hierarchy -> level-1 collapse to 4 codes, recall 0.0513).
OBSERVED: no local re-analysis possible; must design from the brief's numbers only and must not depend on reading the forensic tables at run time.
REASONING: rejected directions already taken: CURVCTRL-SID (hard prefix-transition score -> per-level learning rate), BRad-RQ (context-entropy ranked radial Poincare assignment), poincare-frechet-successor-codebook (Frechet codebook updates), and the mixed-curvature-per-level / Lorentz successor-profile probes. Kept design space: make the *measured, permutation-null-standardised Ollivier curvature of the training-split behaviour quotient graph* the runtime ALLOCATION signal for per-level negative curvature and per-level code radius inside the RQ quantizer itself, with a mean-zero budget so no absolute target or tuning constant is needed, and with level-3 code usage protected as the explicit anti-#127 guard.
STILL OPEN: exact safeguards for the assignment<->curvature feedback loop (EMA, clip, refresh cadence) and the per-step cost arithmetic at 24556 items / 24 steps / 3000 epochs.

STAGE: final answer (curvature as a runtime design target inside the RQ quantizer).
GOAL: one implementable, in-scope mechanism coupling a training-only behaviour signal to an explicit curved operation in ONE path, no ablation run, no tuning, no seeds.
READ: brief's numbers only (no local forensic files; external read denied).
OBSERVED: strongest evidence = level-wise standardised Ollivier curvature profile (L3 +0.26, L1 -0.16, L1-L3 -0.20) and code usage at L3 (+0.42) / collisions (-0.39); Issue #127 collapse risk from forcing coarse partitions.
REASONING: put the measured, permutation-null-standardised quotient curvature on a mean-zero budget that sets per-level Lorentz curvature c_l=c0*exp(-delta_l) and per-level code radius rho_l=rho0*exp(delta_l/2); assignment, residual and codebook all live on the level's own hyperboloid, so changing delta changes the SID. Level 3 becomes flatter/wider (more used codes, anti-#127), level 1 sharper/tighter (anti-collapse). Cost <2%/step and <1% wall clock (15 refreshes, 8 nulls, 256 sampled edges, 30 Sinkhorn iters). Open risks: sign of the curvature->geometry map, loop oscillation (EMA 0.5, clip +-1, T=200), reconstruction faithfulness of the tangent residual chain.
ANSWER: IDEA CURVALLOC-LORENTZ-RQ. Full field block is printed in the response; it names the training-split sequential co-consumption quotient graph, the Lorentz distance/exp/log on curvature -c_l, the coupling equation with c_l and rho_l, the three switches (delta=0 / c->0 / both on) and the safeguards.
